pcs.pc_description: encourage the management to undertake quality accreditation/certification
encourage the management to identify the significance of upgrading and maintaining quality in healthcare organization
develop promotional plan and tools regarding benefits of adherence to quality standards in healthcare organization for its social, economic and clinical growth
organize promotional sessions with staff
develop self-evaluation mechanisms of quality parameters for healthcare personnel and ensure its proper usage
promote leadership and coordination in the field of technology assessment and quality assurance
promote the development of strategic quality indicators by the individual specialties

modules.module_title: develop strategic quality indicators

pcs.pc_description: obtain an informed/written consent from healthcare management for studying the healthcare organization and obtaining the relevant documents, if applicable
obtain and review current standards, protocols, manuals and policies available in healthcare organization
plan and visit all departments of the healthcare organization for surface observation
plan and organize meetings with personnel of each department of healthcare organization for deeper understanding
plan and meet patients at various departments at different times for collecting relevant feedback
analyse the scope of services of the healthcare organization and type of populace served by the healthcare organization
study the organizational structure, various committees and the stakeholders of the healthcare organization
study the current resources of the healthcare organization emphasizing on human and financial resources
study the mission, vision and business plan of the healthcare organization
maintain confidentiality of obtained documents and the recorded findings
maintain the integrity of the documents and protocols
exhibit calm, polite and patient behaviour with healthcare personnel and patients at all times
avoid mis-interpreting oneself as investigating officer and a fault-finder, yet keep a critical eye during visit and meetings

modules.module_title: documentation and maintain proper registers related to quality function

pcs.pc_description: identify the best suited quality standards for the healthcare organization from the various types of available quality standards

plan the broader steps and complete work sequence as per accreditation/ certification process to meet the identified quality standards
set the milestones, targets, resources and timelines in the work sequence
constitute working group from within the healthcare organization who could work as per the work plan effectively for compliance, performance management systems and targets.
discuss the work plan with management and department heads of healthcare organization and take their consensus

modules.module_title: data analytical tools for healthcare quality assurance

orient and monitor the working groups for each developmental activity
set key elements to be captured in each developmental activity
conduct periodic review with each working group for the status of developmental activity against set timelines, resources and target in the work plan

coordinate with different stakeholders for supporting documents and organise meetings with experts for each working group
collaborate with carers to ensure that quality improvement interventions are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and timely
complete the missing elements in the document and discuss it with the respective working groups & management

modules.module_title: Constitute committees depending upon the size of the healthcare organization

pcs.pc_description: reinforce the constitution of the steering and departmental committees
define the aim, objectives and measurable outcomes of the committees
set up the terms of reference of the committees along with timelines, target and resources to meet the desired outcome
ensure the periodicity and nature of meetings of the committees are agreed with committee members

modules.module_title: Perform gap analysis in healthcare organization

pcs.pc_description: orient committees regarding agreed adoption of quality accreditation/ certification standards by the healthcare organization and its objective elements/different sections

discuss the work plan set for achievement of the agreed standards and the documents developed for the various processes, procedures, protocols and standard operating manuals adhering to standards with the respective committees
compare current standards in healthcare organization with the agreed quality standards
compare the vision, mission and business plan of healthcare organization with the agreed quality standards
identify the gaps and strengths based on comparative analysis
identify zero tolerance gaps to be bridged based on agreed quality standards
brainstorm all possible or potential contributing causes and their interrelationships with the identified gaps
summarize the agreed points and present it to the management
derive on final action plan based on discussions and recommendations of management/steering committee on identified gap analysis

modules.module_title: Apply the agreed quality standards to bridge the identified gaps

pcs.pc_description: map the identified gaps with objective elements/ different sections of agreed quality standards
devise mechanism to monitor the improvement strategy adopted to bridge the gaps for each department based on action plan with measurable outcomes
implement the improvement strategy in each department and assess the progress periodically
establish a way to communicate progress to management and highlight the issues faced while implementation and its possible solutions or interventions
bridge all identified and agreed gaps, eliminate all root causes and complete the improvement strategy in defined timelines, resources and targets
organize departmental and steering committee meetings periodically to review the status of implementation of improvement strategy till closure
submit the final report of improvement strategy adopted with its achieved outcomes

pcs.pc_description: organize meeting with the healthcare management, department and personnel to identify the training need based on agreed quality accreditation/ certification standards
map the identified training needs with objective elements and different sections of agreed quality accreditation/certification standards
divide the training objectives into common and specific for whole organization and its departments, respectively
encourage participants to undertake training interventions for better professional outcomes as well as patient care

modules.module_title: Design, create and monitor the program

pcs.pc_description: set the training objectives and outcomes for all employees/ different categories of the employees working in the healthcare organization
create the training program planner as per the appropriate time for content delivery
design the training program involving relevant information and/or instructions related to quality aspects of healthcare organization
create training modules based on identified learning outcome
ensure use of the appropriate training delivery methods as per the target audience
keep periodicity of training programs based on the identified gaps in quality and improvement strategy to be adopted to bridge the same
ensure training aids are developed and various facilitation techniques are used for demonstrating incorporation of quality aspects in healthcare organization
facilitate organization of regular campaign for reinforcing behavioural change in employees of healthcare organization especially for infection control practices
document all training related communication in the healthcare providers record, including the date, time, and signature of the person delivering the training
ensure participant sign-in sheet is verified by departmental head
involve the department heads in the training programs to ensure that they train their respective departments at frequent intervals

modules.module_title: Assess the outcome of the training program

pcs.pc_description: document all participants feedback received during training sessions
conduct pre-training, formative and post- training assessment of the participants & document the findings
implement the documented improvement plan, review and adjust as required
conduct KAP (Knowledge, Attitude and Practices) study periodically

create an internal audit schedule and share with respective departments and relevant healthcare personnel
develop the process of internal audit in consultation with departmental committees

encourage adoption of audit checklist by each stakeholder for carrying out their own periodic audits
conduct the internal audit based on the checklist or processes laid down for the respective department
record the audit findings in the prescribed checklist for discussion with the stakeholders and analyse the trend over period of time
create culture of carrying out both intra- departmental and inter-departmental audits in a friendly manner

modules.module_title: Review the finding of internal audit with relevant stakeholders

pcs.pc_description: prepare summary of audit findings gathered from both intra and inter departmental audits periodically
provide recommendations on improvements to be undertaken for bridging the gaps
present the audit summary to departmental committees as per defined periodicity

present the audit summary to management and discuss the identified gaps, its causative factors, recommendations for improvement and readiness of the healthcare organization for applying to agreed quality accreditation/ certification
build follow up & corrective action plan based on management review in consultation with departmental committees

modules.module_title: Devise the mechanism to improve the healthcare systems for compliance to agreed quality standards

pcs.pc_description: apply the objective elements/different sections of agreed quality standards to bridge the identified gaps
collaborate with healthcare staff to ensure that quality improvement interventions taken are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and timely.
conduct random / surprise effective checking of works and ensure execution of good quality practices by healthcare personnel for overall improvement in efficiency of the organization
review the status of corrective/preventive actions taken within the Quality Assurance cell periodically
ensure protection of patients and family rights during care
structure quality assurance and continuous monitoring programme within the organization
identify key indicators to monitor the clinical & managerial structures, processes and outcomes
establish system for continuous monitoring of patient care services

modules.module_title: Devise the mechanism to improve the healthcare systems for regulatory and statutory compliance

prepare a calendar of actionable points to meet the requirements of statutory compliances
implement suitable redressal mechanism for deviations in the policy, objectives, rules, regulations, applicable legal requirements

resolve all the queries pertaining to documents and reports from relevant personnel
fill in the required details in given application process
channelize financial and manpower resources for due completion of application for accreditation/certification
ensure review of the application file from management/steering committees before applying to the body
ensure receipt of final application file by the agreed quality accreditation/ certification body

modules.module_title: Support healthcare organization before external audit

pcs.pc_description: decipher the external audit process adopted by accreditation/ certification body
map the measures taken by accredited/certified healthcare organizations for readiness for external audits
train healthcare personnel for external audits
organize a mock survey/audit to assess the readiness of the organization
implement final modifications, if any
liaise with accreditation/certification body for any corrective measures to be taken

check for schedule of the external audit and communicate to all relevant personnel in the healthcare organization

support and maintain the patency of documents being asked by the external auditor
accompany the external auditor during the audit rounds
answer queries or concerns being raised by the external auditors
review the report given by external auditor before getting it cross-signed by authorized personnel of the healthcare organization
gather feedback of external auditors regarding the quality processes of healthcare organization

ensure compliance to each concern raised by the body till the grant of provisional/final accreditation/certification
